overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair could not reasonably have anticipated the litigation executive session after the recall election, and minute-taker names are not required.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the Board entered executive session on March 18 without listing it on the meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Here, we find that Chair Panetta did not anticipate the executive session discussion at issue.

allegations.summary: One complainant alleged the Board failed to indicate who took the minutes at the March 18 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: there is no requirement that a public body list the name of the person who creates meeting minutes.
